role: independent verifier (own code under roles/verifier/code/; labels only via frc.common.load, operation verify, inside queue units, logged)
rules: append-only: an entry is never edited or removed; each written version is snapshotted to records/history/ and the hashes of all earlier entries are re-checked before every write
numerical_status (own code recomputes a recorded number) and procedural_status (process, access, record evidence) are recorded separately; values PASS, FAIL, ATTENTION, NOT_APPLICABLE, NOT_RUN
an acceptance rule is never widened after a failure; a corrected check gets a new id and an entry in CHECK_CHANGES.json (before, after, cause); the earlier result is kept

checks.what: source admission replayed label-free with own calls: remote pin of the NRM publication, branch base, pinned private artefacts re-hashed against their own records (TASK.sha256, MODEL.json, RELEASE.json, published GATE blobs) and against SOURCE_ADMISSION.json, source files unmodified since the campaign start, 26 reference MODEL_SELECT wires, interpreter versions

registration receipt re-verified with own git calls (R1): record verified; own ls-remote of publication/pcrl-finite-routing-comparison-v1 on https://github.com/Bostesa/PCRL.git equals the receipt commit; registration files committed, unchanged, equal to the receipt hashes, to the research commit and to the published copies; research commit an ancestor of HEAD and earlier than the verification
frc.common POLICY / ENTRY_POINTS equal the registered ACCESS_POLICY.json

logged row-set hashes, people and households equal the admitted roles (R8)
